If the saved instruction above says to stay quiet when there's nothing to report and there's nothing new, just end the run with no SendToUser rather than sending filler like "(no change.)"; nobody is waiting on this. If it can't be done, SendToUser to say why. If you're already mid-task with them, don't stop: finish that first, then slip this in as a "btw …" aside. Keep it self-contained — the schedule asked for this, not the user just now.
